notes.title: DAF & MEILLER Pack and Cosmetic Pack #3 now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/a08fe9854c3110622a30cf8375e534834e9500ca.jpg[/img]

With the [b]Construction Simulator - DAF & MEILLER Pack[/b] and the [b]Construction Simulator - Cosmetic Pack #3[/b], we are pleased to announce two new DLCs for the game. The two expansion packs are now available in the digital stores  - introducing New Generation DAF trucks and a selection of new dumpers by MEILLER Kipper as well as two stylish sets for customizing your player outfits in the game!

[previewyoutube=YULLTz5YuP0;full][/previewyoutube]

With the [b]Construction Simulator - DAF & MEILLER Pack[/b], you get access to brand-new trucks from the popular Dutch manufacturer DAF as well as a selection of new dumpers from the renowned German manufacturer MEILLER Kipper - including an additional semi-trailer dumper for your machine park. Here is an overview of the vehicles, attachments and trailer included:
[list]
[*] DAF XG+ FTM (8x4) tractor
[*] DAF XFC FTT (6x4) tractor
[*] DAF XFC FAD (8x4) with MEILLER ASM asphalt dumper
[*] DAF XDC FAD (8x4) with MEILLER TRIGENIUS® D428 dumper
[*] DAF XFC FAD (8x4) with MEILLER MAXTREME® P450 dumper

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/3c0e126a43fc3369189d7852958eb44b310ddf5f.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile, the [b]Construction Simulator - Cosmetic Pack #3[/b] adds two stylish equipment sets to customize your player character. While the dinosaur set (consisting of goggles, headgear and ear muffs) gives a prehistoric flair for your everyday work, the second set, consisting of a beverage helmet including soda cans as well as matching ear protection and goggles, ensures that you are always refreshed and ready for action!

The [b]Construction Simulator - DAF & MEILLER Pack[/b] and the [b]Construction Simulator - Cosmetic Pack #3[/b] are now available on the digital stores. Alternatively, both DLCs are also included in the [b]Construction Simulator - Year 2 Season Pass[/b].

notes.title: Construction Simulator – Update #14 available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/ff3a7ad784a5252132ffbe8003e545642e0abea6.jpg[/img]

With Update #14 we are excited to bring you new exchangeable parts for the Wacker Neuson ET145 and EW100 excavators, plus a number of bug fixes and general improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. So, pick the perfect bucket for your task and start digging!


[b]Patchnotes - Update #14:[/b]

[b]Exchangeable buckets on Wacker Neuson excavators:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can change the bucket in the context menu in the new “buckets” section when sitting in the associated machine. The following buckets can now be used on these machines:
[list]
[*] ET145: Backhoe Bucket 600 with Teeth, Backhoe Bucket 900 with Teeth, Ditch cleaning bucket 2000
[*] EW100: Backhoe Bucket 600 with Teeth, Backhoe Bucket 900 with Teeth, Ditch cleaning bucket 1500
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes and game improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugfixes regarding Achievements:
[list]
[*] There was a bug that caused Achievements that were dependent on playing time to be unlocked too late or not at all. After a long search, this bug has now been fixed.
[*] In addition, security checks at the launch of the game have been integrated in the software's background.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Some PC players were experiencing an issue where they could get stuck in the start screen (press any key) and not being able to start the game. This has to do with a corrupted UserData. A mechanism that recognizes this issue and recreates the UserData after confirmation has been implemented.
[/list]
[list]
[*] General bugfixes and improvements, among other:
[list]
[*] The voice chat display is now hidden in photo mode.
[*] A floodlight that was blocking the crane area in an EU single-family home contract was moved.
[*] Fixed further bugs that caused vehicles to falsely shoot in the air when using fast travel via the map.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Several minor vehicle fixes and improvements, among other:
[list]
[*] Fixed flying windows on Hamm compactor H11i.
[*] Fixed the joystick of the JCB 220X excavator clipping through the windshield.
[/list]
[/list]

Have fun and stay safe on the construction sites!

Your Construction Simulator team

notes.title: Construction Simulator - Stadium Expansion now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/0a72ac1e1b587d3f01a6335bd7bae7069d064fbd.jpg[/img]

Before the ball starts rolling at this year's European Football Championship, some final preparations still need to be made. Accordingly, we are pleased to announce the release of the [b]Construction Simulator - Stadium Expansion[/b] today. The new DLC is now available on the digital stores and offers construction fans who also love soccer the opportunity to build a football stadium on the game's European map - the Friedenberg Arena and its associated infrastructure!

[previewyoutube=nlk2QOBK9ws;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Construction Simulator - Stadium Expansion[/b]
[list]
[*] Latest DLC introduces a new campaign for the European map - the construction of a football stadium and its associated infrastructure!
[*] More than 30 hours of additional playtime!
[*] Now available as DLC on the digital stores for 12.99 EUR / 12.99 USD (SRP).
[*] Alternatively, also available as part of the Construction Simulator - Year 2 Season Pass - at an attractive bundle price with more than 40% discount!
[/list]


With the [b]Construction Simulator - Stadium Expansion[/b], you get access to a new major contract. Within the extensive campaign, players not only have to build a football stadium complete with stands, VIP lounges and an impressive entrance area, but also demonstrate their skills in building the associated infrastructure. Whether working on the new pedestrian bridge, the large parking space, the multi-storey car park or the clubhouse of the Friedenberg Arena - the varied construction jobs require skilled craftsmanship and almost all of your machinery. Once the stadium is complete and the floodlights have been installed, it is finally time for kick-off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2657390/


Alternatively, the game expansion is also available as part of the [b]Construction Simulator - Year 2 Season Pass[/b], which is available at an attractive bundle price with a discount of more than 40% for 24.99 EUR / 24.99 USD (SRP) on the digital stores. In addition to the brand-new Stadium Expansion, the Year 2 Season Pass also includes the recently released Liebherr Pack with 6 machines by the popular manufacturer, an exclusive Year 2 Season Pass Pickup Truck, as well as the upcoming DLCs of the Year 2 Season. These include the Cosmetic Pack #3 and two further vehicle packs with new construction machinery for the player's fleet.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666240/


[b]Construction Simulator - Titanium Edition[/b]
For newcomers to the construction business, the [b]Construction Simulator - Titanium Edition[/b] is now available on the digital stores. In addition to the main game, the Titanium Edition also includes all previously released add-on packs - including the Kramer Pack, the Car & Bobblehead Pack, the Customization Kit, as well as all content from the Year 1 Season Pass and the Year 2 Season Pass!
If you already own the main game or some of the DLCs - here on Steam, missing content can be completed variably and at a reduced price with the Titanium Edition too.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31687/


We wish you a lot of fun with the new campaign!

Your Constrction Simulator team

notes.title: Construction Simulator - Update #11 now available for download!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/3f17bcb0348a12c3a37fe35f0a77795060f627ac.jpg[/img]

Good news: We just released Update #11 for Construction Simulator on PC, PlayStation and Xbox! For the first time in the history of the game series, the update opens the possibility to work together with players on other platforms in multiplayer and, if desired, communicate together via the new in-game voice chat. Another new feature are the new emotes for the players' characters! And not to forget: For mobile excavators, it is now possible to switch between driving and functional mode without resetting the body, boom and bucket! And…of course, there are also numerous fixes and general game improvements too!

[u][b]New Feature: Crossplay Multiplayer[/b][/u]
[b]Added crossplay[/b]: It is now possible to join multiplayer sessions from any platform – regardless, if you are playing the PC version on Steam, the Microsoft Store version or on PlayStation or Xbox.
[list]
[*] Added option to disable crossplay functionality in the settings under ONLINE. Crossplay is enabled by default for all platforms
[*] When creating a multiplayer game, crossplay can be enabled or disabled for that particular session
[/list]

[u][b]New Feature: Voice Chat[/b][/u]
[b]Added voice chat for all platforms[/b]: Most related settings can be found under AUDIO > VOICE CHAT (only appears in-game, not in the main menu):
[list]
[*] Option for enabling/disabling voice chat
[*] Option for changing the audio output and input devices
[*] Option for setting voice chat volume
[*] Radio sound effect when players are far away from each other (can be deactivated)
[*] Possibility to block/unblock communication with other players
[*] Option for activating/deactivating push-to-talk
[*] Option to assign the button for push-to-talk under CONTROLS > HUD/MENU. Default key on a keyboard is “Left Alt”
[/list]
[i]
Note: There are still some known issues regarding this new feature. We are working on them and will try to fix them in the future, but we can't make any promises yet.
[list]
[*] Voice chat quality is frame rate dependent and can therefore be poor on last-gen devices
[*] Last-gen-devices have issues with the voice chat sound after activating the microphone test in the audio settings. This can be fixed by restarting the game
[/list]
[/i]

[u][b]New Feature: Emotes[/b][/u]
[b]Added player emotes for the player’s characters in the game[/b]
[list]
[*] In the context menu, there is a new sub-category called EMOTES
[*] Each emote can also be assigned to a specific shortcut under CONTROLS > CHARACTER
[*] Some emotes are played as one-shot animations, after which the character will automatically return to their normal position
[*] For some emotes, the character will remain in a certain pose, until a new movement input is made
[/list]

[u][b]Mobile Excavator Improvements[/b][/u]
It is now possible for wheeled hydraulic excavators to switch between driving and function mode without resetting the body, boom and bucket. Wheeled hydraulic excavators can now be used in the following ways:
[list]
[*] Driving while the shovel is filled with bulk
[*] Driving while transporting cargo
[*] Transporting a concrete bucket and pouring concrete while driving
[*] Rotate the body 180° to enable rear wheel steering
[/list]

[u][b]Multiple Vehicle Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Final changes on the amount of bulk material which excavator and dumpers can hold
[*] and many small fixes and improvements
[/list]

[u][b]General Game Improvements[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Some graphical fixes and improvements
[*] A number of general bugfixes and improvements
[/list]

We wish you lots of fun on the construction sites!

Your Construction Simulator team

True to the slogan “GET TO WORK”, today we are happy to announce the long-awaited next instalment in the Construction Simulator series. Regardless if you are playing in the US-American or the European setting: thanks to the completely open game worlds with a dynamic day and night cycle and the entirely revised mission system including its two campaigns as well as a multitude of varied and challenging missions, in Construction Simulator you are free in your decisions on how to lead your company to success.

Next to this, the game will excite you with its completely revamped, modern graphics and an improved vehicle and earthmoving system, as well as a sophisticated cooperative multiplayer mode. Another new feature of Construction Simulator: officially licensed work clothes!
